description: Program-wide findings on the real records the Upper C-band Clearinghouse will pay against: call signs whose registrant changed since the 2020 / 2025 lists, control groups, dish locations filed under two or more call signs (antennas and dollars), registrants with foreign-adversary flags, FAA registrations that expire before the Oct 31 2034 deadline, ownership changes since the order, co-owned aircraft, N-numbers previously on another airframe. With build date and sources. Free.

title: Upper C-band program integrity findings
